strings.Quanto è fitta la griglia della foschia:: How fine the haze grid is: 1 = draft (1 million cells), 2 = normal (4 million), 3 = high (12 million), 4 = maximum (24 million, 48 MB). Higher = fine detail and sharp edges, longer computation (the bar at the bottom shows the progress)
strings.Uno strato di pochi centimetri che alegg: A layer a few centimetres thick hovering over the floor, gathered into filaments like toxic smoke
strings.Veli orizzontali sovrapposti a quote div: Horizontal veils stacked at different heights, wavy and full of holes, like haze in a valley
strings.Vortici dentro i vortici, con contrasto: Swirls inside swirls, with high contrast: clearly visible curls and spirals of vapour
strings.Acceso: la foschia mostra solo la luce d: On: the haze shows only the light of spots, sun and lamps crossing it (the rays), without veiling or darkening the objects. Off: physical haze, veiling everything with the environment light
strings.Cartone animato (cel shading): colori pi: Cartoon (cel shading): flat colours in three sharp bands (light, half shadow, shadow) from the scene lights, hard shadows and a crisp highlight on shiny materials. Glass and mirrors stay real
strings.Diametro medio dei granelli: più grandi: Average speck diameter: larger = more visible dots (below the size of a pixel the denoiser mistakes them for noise)
strings.Ferma la foschia a un'altezza dal pavime: Stops the haze at a height above the floor, except for a few rising puffs
strings.Fino a che altezza dal pavimento arriva: How high above the floor the haze reaches
strings.Granelli nell'aria che si vedono solo de: Specks in the air that show only inside the beams of spots and sun, like the dust in the rays coming through a window: elsewhere they are invisible
strings.Illustrazione da manuale tecnico (Gooch): Technical-manual illustration (Gooch): soft shading from warm in the light to cool in the shadow, with no black shadows, so shapes and volumes read clearly. Nice with outlines
strings.La luce come nella realtà: riflessi, rif: Light as in reality: reflections, refractions, soft shadows and bounce light (path tracing)
strings.Linee anche dove due facce dello stesso: Lines also where two faces of the same object form a sharp angle
strings.Linee scure su sagome, confini tra ogget: Dark lines on silhouettes, object borders and sharp edges, drawn over the final image: they work with any style
strings.Più basso = più linee (anche su angoli p: Lower = more lines (also on soft angles)
strings.Quanto brillano i granelli nel fascio: How much the specks shine in the beam
strings.Quanto è spessa l'aria (1/m): più alta =: How thick the air is (1/m): higher = brighter rays and, if the haze is physical, more veiled objects
strings.Scala della densità: a questa distanza u: Density scale: at this distance an object would disappear in the haze (sooner where it is denser, later where it is thinner)
strings.Si vede solo dentro i fasci di spot e so: It shows only inside the beams of spots and sun: it needs a ray crossing the air. Bulbs, panels, environment and bounce light do not light it.
strings.0 = bordo netto, 1 = il fumo sfuma piano: 0 = sharp edge, 1 = the smoke fades gently into the air
strings.Altezza dello strato di fumo sopra il pa: Height of the smoke layer above the floor (or above the start height)
strings.Altra disposizione di riccioli e sbuffi: Another arrangement of curls and puffs
strings.Bianco = vapore, grigio = fumo, scuro =: White = steam, grey = smoke, dark = soot that absorbs light
strings.Da che altezza dal pavimento comincia la: Height above the floor where the haze begins (below it, only a few hanging puffs)
strings.Da che altezza sopra il fondo del riquad: Height above the bottom of the box where the smoke begins
strings.Dimensione dei riccioli e degli sbuffi p: Size of the largest curls and puffs; the fine details scale down from here
strings.Esce stretto dal fondo del riquadro, sal: Comes out narrow from the bottom of the box, widens as it rises and fades away
strings.Fa cominciare il fumo più in alto del fo: Makes the smoke begin higher than the bottom of the box
strings.Fa partire la foschia da un'altezza dal: Starts the haze at a height above the floor instead of at ground level: together with the maximum height this gives a suspended band, for example from 2.2 to 2.8 m under the ceiling
strings.Ferma il fumo a un'altezza sopra il fond: Stops the smoke at a height above the bottom of the box
strings.Fino a che altezza sopra il fondo del ri: How high above the bottom of the box the smoke reaches
strings.Il fumo non entra dentro gli oggetti del: The smoke does not enter the scene objects that cross the box
strings.Il riquadro è la zona in cui esiste il f: The box is the zone where the smoke exists: select it and move or resize it with the gizmo (Move / Scale) in the viewport.
strings.Lobi tondi a cavolfiore sul bordo, tipic: Round cauliflower lobes on the edge, typical of dense, billowing smoke
strings.Mette il fondo del riquadro sopra i comp: Puts the bottom of the box on top of the selected components (or at the bottom of the scene)
strings.Nubi di fumo vere, con riccioli, sbuffi: Real smoke clouds, with curls, puffs and frayed edges, in a box you move and resize with the gizmo: incense, steam, plumes, dense smoke
strings.Ottave del frattale: 1–2 = forme morbide: Fractal octaves: 1–2 = large soft shapes, 6–10 = ever finer details inside the shapes (high quality is needed to see them)
strings.Ottave del frattale: 1–3 = morbido, 6–10: Fractal octaves: 1–3 = soft, 6–10 = ever finer details (high quality needed)
strings.Quanti sbuffi salgono a caso sopra l'alt: How many puffs rise at random above the maximum height and hang below the start height: 0 = clean cut
strings.Quanto i bordi si sfilacciano in fili so: How much the edges fray into thin threads
strings.Quanto il fumo manda la luce in avanti:: How much the smoke scatters light forward: high = it glows when looking towards the light, like smoke in a beam
strings.Quanto il fumo si attorciglia: 0 = forme: How much the smoke twists: 0 = soft shapes, 1–2 = curls, 4–8 = extreme swirls
strings.Quanto il fumo si dirada salendo: 0 = de: How much the smoke thins out as it rises: 0 = dense all the way up
strings.Quanto il rumore viene attorcigliato: 0: How much the noise is twisted: 0 = round blobs, 1.5 = rippled banks, 3–4 = clearly visible curls and spirals, 6–8 = extreme swirls
strings.Quanto la colonna ondeggia salendo: How much the column sways as it rises
strings.Quanto la colonna si apre salendo: 0 = r: How much the column opens up as it rises: 0 = stays narrow, 1 = as wide as the box
strings.Quanto pesano i dettagli fini: bassa = b: How much the fine details weigh: low = soft edges, high = jagged
strings.Quanto è fitta la griglia del fumo: 1 =: How fine the smoke grid is: 1 = draft (up to 3 million cells), 2 = normal (7), 3 = high (14), 4 = maximum (24). Higher = fine details and sharp edges, longer computation
strings.Quanto è spesso il fumo pieno (1/m): 5–2: How thick the full smoke is (1/m): 5–20 = light and transparent, 50–150 = dense, above 300 = almost opaque. Thin threads (incense) need more to be visible
strings.Riempie tutto il riquadro con i bordi sf: Fills the whole box with frayed edges
strings.Seleziona: il gizmo sposta e ridimension: Select: the gizmo moves and resizes the smoke box
strings.Sottile e liscio in basso, poi si rompe: Thin and smooth at the bottom, then breaks into curls as it rises
strings.Spessore di fumo pieno oltre il quale no: Thickness of full smoke beyond which you can no longer see through it
strings.Un ammasso tondeggiante che riempie il r: A rounded mass filling the box, suspended in mid-air
strings.Zone grandi più dense e altre più tenui,: Large denser zones and fainter ones scattered through the scene: 0 = the same everywhere, 1 = marked clumps and gaps, 2 = few, very concentrated clumps
strings.Zone più dense e più rade dentro la nube: Denser and thinner zones inside the cloud: 0 = uniform
strings.Un ammasso di fumo morbido a mezz'aria,: A soft mass of smoke in mid-air, with puffs and frayed edges
strings.Un filo sottile che sale liscio e poi si: A thin thread that rises smoothly and then breaks into curls: put the bottom of the box on the tip of the stick
strings.Simulazione fisica: vapore bianco e legg: Physical simulation: light white steam rising slowly from the cup in curling filaments that fade away: put the bottom of the box on the surface of the coffee, the source is as wide as the cup
strings.Fumo che esce da un tubo, un ugello o un: Smoke coming out of a pipe, nozzle or chimney, widening as it rises and opening into puffs: put the bottom of the box on the opening
strings.Fumo scuro e pesante che si gonfia in gr: Dark, heavy smoke that swells into big puffs: smokestacks, fires, dramatic scenes
strings.Fumo che riempie tutto il riquadro con i: Smoke filling the whole box with frayed edges: a smoke-filled room, a stage, a layer under the ceiling
strings.0 = fumo freddo (non sale), 1 = caldo ti: 0 = cold smoke (does not rise), 1 = typical hot smoke, 3 or more = very hot, rises fast
strings.0° = fascia orizzontale, 90° = verticale: 0° = horizontal band, 90° = vertical, in between = tilted
strings.Aggiungi una camera di rendering dalla v: Add a render camera from the current view
strings.Agitazione dell'aria: rompe la colonna i: Air agitation: breaks the column into puffs
strings.Alto = gas pesante che scende e si stend: High = heavy gas that sinks and spreads over the surface (like dry ice)
strings.Celle della simulazione sul lato più lun: Simulation cells on the longest side: 1 = 48, 2 = 72, 3 = 100, 4 = 136. Higher = finer motion, much longer computation
strings.Copia la transizione di sopra anche sott: Copy the upper transition to the lower one
strings.Dettaglio fine sul bordo (sopra la simul: Fine detail on the edge (on top of the simulation):
strings.Dove la camera non vede niente (lo sfond: Where the camera sees nothing (the background, not the floor) this colour replaces the environment; the scene is still lit by the environment as before
strings.Dove passa la fascia nitida: 0 = bordo i: Where the sharp band runs: 0 = top edge, 0.5 = centre, 1 = bottom edge (or left / right if the band is vertical)
strings.Effetto plastico: una fascia nitida e il: Miniature effect: a sharp band and the rest blurred, on the final image. It is separate from the depth of field: aperture, focal length and focus do not change; if the depth of field is on too, the band adds to the lens blur
strings.Forma scelta e rumore frattale: immediat: Chosen shape and fractal noise: instant, full control of the shape
strings.Grandezza della bocca da cui esce il fum: Size of the opening the smoke comes out of (a sphere around the source point)
strings.I granelli fermano la luce: piccole sago: The specks block the light: small dark shapes inside the beams (with haze) and on the lit surface. They show best with a few large specks
strings.Il bersaglio segue il centro dell'oggett: The target follows the centre of the object: the camera keeps it centred even if you move it
strings.Il bersaglio torna un punto libero: The target becomes a free point again
strings.Lo stesso sotto (o a destra) della fasci: The same below (or to the right of) the band: the two transitions are independent of the sharp width
strings.Lo stesso stile in grigi, senza i colori: The same style in greys, without the material colours: cartoon with the same bands in black and white, technical illustration like a pencil drawing (off = in colour, as before)
strings.Nessuna: il render usa la vista: None: the render uses the view
strings.Niente linea sul bordo del pavimento: No line on the floor edge
strings.Pavimento, fondali e pareti non hanno la: Floors, backdrops and walls get no line where they end against the background; the silhouettes of the objects standing on them stay
strings.Quanto fumo esce al secondo: How much smoke comes out per second
strings.Quanto il caldo spinge verso l'alto: How strongly the heat pushes upwards
strings.Quanto presto il fumo si raffredda e sme: How soon the smoke cools down and stops rising
strings.Quanto presto il fumo svanisce nell'aria: How soon the smoke fades into the air
strings.Quanto spazio serve, sopra (o a sinistra: How much space it takes, above (or to the left of) the band, to go from sharp to fully blurred: 0 = hard edge
strings.Quanto è larga la fascia del tutto nitid: How wide the fully sharp band is (fraction of the image height): 0 = just a line
strings.Riccioli che nascono nel moto (confiname: Curls that arise in the motion (vorticity confinement)
strings.Riquadro attorno agli oggetti fino alle: Box around the objects up to the spots (at most 6 m per side)
strings.Secondi di simulazione: l'istante che si: Seconds of simulation: the instant frozen for the render
strings.Seleziona il riquadro: il gizmo lo spost: Select the box: the gizmo moves and resizes it (Move / Scale). The specks exist only inside it: it must contain the whole beam, down to the lit surface
strings.Seleziona: il gizmo sposta la camera, la: Select: the gizmo moves the camera, orbits it around the target (Rotate) or moves the target (click the diamond in the viewport)
strings.Sensibilità ai salti di profondità dentr: Sensitivity to depth jumps within the same object: lower = lines also where one part passes just in front of another; higher = only clear separations (3% = as before)
strings.Sfocatura massima ai bordi: raggio in pe: Maximum blur at the edges: radius as a percentage of the image width
strings.Simulazione fisica: il fumo esce da una: Physical simulation: the smoke comes out of a source, heat rises, heavy gas sinks, swirls arise by themselves and objects deflect it. It is frozen at the chosen instant (a few seconds of computation)
strings.Sposta solo il punto inquadrato: la came: Moves only the framed point: the camera stays still and changes direction
strings.Sposta: camera e bersaglio insieme (stes: Move: camera and target together (same direction). Rotate: the camera orbits around the target
strings.Toglie i pezzi di linea più corti di cos: Removes line pieces shorter than this (isolated dots and dashes); real silhouettes and edges are long and stay. 0 = no cleanup
strings.Un oggetto vicino e nitido non sbava sul: A near, sharp object does not bleed into the blurred background (no halos around objects)
strings.Velocità con cui il fumo esce dalla sorg: Speed at which the smoke leaves the source (m/s): negative = downwards
strings.Simulazione fisica: fumo caldo che esce: Physical simulation: hot smoke coming out of the bottom of the box, rising, widening and curling by itself
strings.Simulazione fisica di un gas freddo e pe: Physical simulation of a cold, heavy gas that comes out, sinks and spreads over the surface, flowing around the objects
strings.Aggiunge un file di palette (.ase, .json: Adds a palette file (.ase, .json, .csv) to the Colours folder of the library
strings.Clic: selettore colore (RGB, CMYK, palet: Click: colour picker (RGB, CMYK, RAL palette)
strings.Conversione matematica semplice in RGB,: Simple mathematical conversion to RGB, without a print profile: for entering a colour given in CMYK, not for predicting the print.
strings.Il fumo si muove da 0 a {} s, poi ripart: The smoke moves from 0 to {} s, then starts again
strings.Il gizmo sposta la sorgente del fumo (Sp: The gizmo moves the smoke source (Move) or changes its radius (Scale); in the viewport it is the light blue sphere, which can also be selected with a click
strings.Mostra nella viewport, come una nuvola d: Shows in the viewport, as a cloud of points, where the smoke goes and how it moves up to the chosen instant (a coarse, fast simulation, only for finding position and settings: the render redoes it finely)
strings.Riquadro grande per la sorgente: celle d: Box too large for the source: simulation cells of {} cm, source of {} cm. The smoke is born in a few lumps and a heavy gas can vanish into the floor: shrink the box around the smoke, raise the quality or widen the source.
strings.Valori RGB indicativi, non ufficiali RAL: Indicative RGB values, not official RAL values (average of public sources): for exact colours use RAL samples or import the official RAL digital colour library (.ase) with «Import…».
strings.Quanto la dimensione dei granelli si sco: How much the grain size varies at random around the set size: 0 = all the same, 50 % = from half to double, 100 % = from tiny to triple
strings.Granelli semitrasparenti: diffondono men: Semi-transparent grains: they scatter less light and, if they cast shadows, block only part of it
strings.Parte dei granelli con il secondo colore: Share of grains with the second colour (0 = all of the first)
strings.Granelli tondi: diffondono la luce ugual: Round grains: they scatter light evenly on every side
strings.Scaglie piatte orientate a caso, come po: Flat flakes facing random directions, like fairy dust or glitter: they reflect like tiny mirrors, so only those turned the right way between light and camera sparkle and the others stay dark
strings.Parte della luce riflessa a specchio dal: Share of the light the flakes reflect like a mirror (the rest is diffuse)
strings.Bassa: poche scintille piccole e intense: Low: few small, intense sparkles. High: more flakes lit, but fainter
strings.Tutti i componenti con questo materiale: All components with this material switch to the selected one, without selecting them
strings.Tutti i componenti con il primo material: All components with the first material (also those inheriting it, and the scene default) switch to the selected one, without having to select them
strings.· solo anteprima, il render non lo calc: · preview only, the render does not compute it
strings.Spento: il fumo resta solo come anteprim: Off: the smoke stays only as a point preview in the viewport (fast) and the render does not run the full simulation. Useful to set position, source and how it flows around objects; then turn it back on for the real render
strings.Solo anteprima: nel render questo fumo n: Preview only: this smoke is not in the render until you turn the full computation back on.
